name: PlantDisease AI tomato leaf classifier
architecture: MobileNetV2 backbone + global average pooling + dropout (0.3) + dense softmax
training: Transfer learning with a frozen backbone (feature extraction only)
dataset: PlantVillage tomato classes (10 categories, lab photos of single leaves)

evaluation.source: Measured with plantdisease.evaluation on the leakage-aware PlantVillage test split. This model's original training split is unknown, so some test photos may have been seen in training.
